defs.meaning: 不顾，不加理会；不管怎样，无论如何

examples.en: She always travels first-class regardless of expense.
examples.zh: 无论费用多高她总是乘头等舱。

examples.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
examples.zh: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to good medical care regardless of their ability to pay.
examples.zh: 无论支付能力如何，每个人都有权得到良好的医疗。
